sources.name: YouGov Ratings: most popular video games in America (top 20 opened; Q3 2026 data)
sources.method: US public panel, share with positive opinion. Ranks used: Super Mario Bros. 1, Spider-Man 2 and Marvel's Spider-Man 3, Mario Kart 8 4, Minecraft 5, Candy Crush Saga 7, GTA V 8, Sonic 9, Legend of Zelda 10, GTA 11, Call of Duty 15, Angry Birds 17, Super Smash Bros. 18, Mortal Kombat 19.

sources.name: Wikipedia: List of best-selling video games (top 30 opened)
sources.method: Units sold worldwide: Tetris 520M and Minecraft 425M tied at 1, GTA V 2, RDR2 3, Wii Sports 4, Mario Kart 8 5, Skyrim 8, Super Mario Bros. 10, Animal Crossing NH 12, The Sims 13, Pokemon Red/Blue/Yellow 16, Sonic 20, Zelda BotW 26.

sources.name: National Today National Video Games Day survey (as reported by KPEL 96.5)
sources.method: Favorite franchise share: Super Mario 47, Call of Duty 21, Donkey Kong 19, GTA 19, Pokemon 16, Zelda 13, Sonic 13, Final Fantasy 9, Halo 9, Crash Bandicoot 7. Sample size and country not stated; Sept 2018.

sources.name: Morning Consult / The Hollywood Reporter poll: which game franchise adults want as a movie
sources.method: 2,200 US adults, Feb 2020. Super Mario Bros. first (44%); Pac-Man and Donkey Kong lead among parents; Call of Duty among men; Tetris fifth among women. Interest/awareness, not favorites.

sources.name: Guinness World Records: Most recognizable video game character (Davie-Brown Index)
sources.method: May 2008 Davie-Brown Index of American consumers: Pac-Man recognized by 94%.
